policy: Stable person_id bindings only; official list ordinals and runtime IDs are not NES IDs. Same-name candidates and uncertain ROM names remain unbound, and receive new art instead.
transcription: 237 original ROM name records manually transcribed from rendered glyph pixels; orthographic forms may resolve to the same exact identity, but similar names never merge distinct people.
normalization_note: Only displayed traditional/Japanese orthographic variants are normalized for the exact-match review. No pronunciation-only, surname-only, ordinal-based or statistical matching.

evidence.name_pixels: original ROM glyph decoding; no OCR-inferred Unicode stored in the ROM
